description: Points d'accès WIFI - Ville de Clermont-Ferrand is a dataset listed in opendata.clermontmetropole.eu open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Clermont Auvergne Métropole. Liste et localisation des points Wifi accessibles gratuitement au public sur la commune de Clermont-Ferrand Producteur: Direction de Usages Numériques (DUN). Coverage: Clermont Auvergne Métropole. The portal files it under Espace public. Its keywords are Numérique, Aménagement du territoire, Urbanisme, Bâtiments, Équipements. The portal shows 15 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermontmetropole-eu-portal.
